clues.text: As Jesus traveled along, He entered a village where this woman welcomed Him into her home.
Busy with preparations, she asked Jesus whether He cared that her sister had left her to serve alone.
Jesus said her name twice and told her she was worried and upset about many things.
Hearing Jesus was coming to Bethany after her brother died, she went out to meet Him while her sister stayed home.
After she said her brother would rise at the last day, Jesus told her, "I am the resurrection and the life."
Grieving her brother Lazarus, she told Jesus she believed He was the Christ, the Son of God.
When Jesus said to take away the stone from the tomb, she warned that after four days he would stink.
